summary: Universal Safety Products filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with SJC Lending LLC for the sale of up to $10.6 million aggregate principal amount of convertible promissory notes at an aggregate purchase price of up to $10.0 million. The agreement contemplates eleven tranche closings, with the initial tranche of $1.06 million principal for $1.0 million closed on the execution date. Conversion of notes exceeding 19.99% of outstanding common stock requires stockholder approval. This is a financing arrangement, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms are stated as this is not an M&A or special situation event.
